How do I book a consultation?
Go to the Dashboard and tap "Book Consultation". Select your preferred doctor, date, and time slot to complete your booking.
How can I view my health records?
Navigate to "Health Records" from the Dashboard. All your uploaded documents, prescriptions, and reports will be available there.
What is the QR code feature?
The QR code allows healthcare providers to quickly access your medical information during emergencies. You can find it on the Dashboard.
How do I set medication reminders?
Tap the "Reminder" tab in the bottom navigation to create and manage your medication reminders.
Can I change my profile information?
Yes. Go to Settings and then Edit Profile to update your personal information, contact details, and emergency contacts.
How do I reset my password?
Go to Settings and then Change Password. You will need to enter your current password and then set a new one.
Yes, all your data is encrypted and stored securely. We follow strict healthcare data protection standards. Read our Privacy Policy for more details.
How do I cancel a consultation?
Go to your consultation history, select the appointment you want to cancel, and tap "Cancel Appointment". Cancellation policies may apply.
Can I upload my own medical documents?
Yes, you can upload medical documents through the Health Records section. Supported formats include PDF, JPG, and PNG.
We accept major debit cards, credit cards, mobile wallets, and online banking for consultation payments.

We collect information you provide directly to us, including:

• Personal information (name, email, phone number, date of birth)
• Health information (medical records, prescriptions, blood group)
• Emergency contact details
• Location data for emergency services
• Usage data and app interactions

We use the collected information to:

• Provide and maintain our healthcare services
• Process appointments and consultations
• Store and manage your health records securely
• Send medication reminders and notifications
• Improve our app features and user experience
• Comply with legal obligations

We take your data security seriously:

• All data is encrypted in transit and at rest
• We use industry-standard security protocols
• Regular security audits and updates
• Secure cloud storage infrastructure (Firebase)
• Limited access to authorized personnel only

We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:

• Healthcare providers you have authorized
• Emergency services when necessary
• Service providers who assist our operations
• Legal authorities when required by law

You have the right to:

• Access your personal data
• Correct inaccurate information
• Request deletion of your data
• Opt out of marketing communications
• Download your health records
• Withdraw consent at any time
We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. Medical records are retained according to healthcare regulations and legal requirements in Nepal.

Our service is not intended for users under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.

We use third party services for:

• Authentication and database (Firebase)
• Cloud storage and hosting
• Payment processing
• Analytics and crash reporting

These services have their own privacy policies.
